title: A Colony for the Static
author: Dominic Joubert
blurb: Ines Dunmore, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
